summary: EquipmentShare.com Inc filed an 8-K reporting the upsize and pricing of a private offering of $1,350 million aggregate principal amount of senior secured second lien notes due 2034, increased by $300 million from the prior announced size. The notes bear 7.125% interest, priced at 100% of principal, and are offered to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a debt financing event, not a special-situation transaction; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
